# Rule catalog

<!-- Generated by `bitwright catalog`; do not edit. -->

The built-in rules: `core.bwr`, the local rules the engine links by default, and `eqsat.bwr`, the equations of the equality-saturation search. Every rule is checked (and recorded in the file's proof ledger) and every example holds.

## `core.bwr`

### core.bitwise

#### `and_absorb_or` — rule

Absorption.

```text
rule and_absorb_or<W>(x: W, y: W) { x & (x | y) => x }
```

- `(q | p) & p` → `p`

#### `or_absorb_and` — rule

Absorption.

```text
rule or_absorb_and<W>(x: W, y: W) { x | (x & y) => x }
```

- `(q & p) | p` → `p`

#### `and_not_self` — rule

Complement.

```text
rule and_not_self<W>(x: W) { x & ~x => 0 }
```

- `p & ~p` → `0:8`

#### `or_not_self` — rule

Complement.

```text
rule or_not_self<W>(x: W) { x | ~x => ones }
```

- `p | ~p` → `255:8`

#### `xor_not_self` — rule

Complement.

```text
rule xor_not_self<W>(x: W) { x ^ ~x => ones }
```

- `p ^ ~p` → `255:8`

#### `xor_and_or` — rule

The and and the or of two values differ exactly in their xor.

```text
rule xor_and_or<W>(x: W, y: W) { (x & y) ^ (x | y) => x ^ y }
```

- `(p & q) ^ (p | q)` → `p ^ q`

#### `and_mask_redundant` — rule

A mask that keeps every bit the value may have set.

```text
rule and_mask_redundant<W>(x: W, c: const W) { x & c => x if zero_bits(x, ~c) }
```

- `(q & 15) & 0x3f` → `q & 15`

#### `and_mask_disjoint` — rule

A mask that keeps none of the bits the value may have set.

```text
rule and_mask_disjoint<W>(x: W, c: const W) { x & c => 0 if zero_bits(x, c) }
```

- `(q & 0xf0) & 15` → `0:8`

#### `or_known_ones` — rule

Setting bits that are already set.

```text
rule or_known_ones<W>(x: W, c: const W) { x | c => x if one_bits(x, c) }
```

- `(q | 0x81) | 1` → `q | 0x81`

### core.arith

#### `add_and_or` — identity (directed and search)

And plus or is plus.

```text
identity add_and_or<W>(x: W, y: W) { (x & y) + (x | y) <=> x + y }
```

- `(p & q) + (p | q)` → `p + q`

#### `add_xor_and` — identity (directed and search)

Xor plus twice the and is plus. (Twice is written as the shift `mul_pow2` makes of it:
patterns are written in normal form, or bottom-up rewriting never reaches them.)

```text
identity add_xor_and<W>(x: W, y: W) { (x ^ y) + ((x & y) << 1) <=> x + y }
```

- `(p ^ q) + ((p & q) << 1)` → `p + q`

#### `or_from_xor_and` — rule

Xor plus and is or (the two parts share no bits).

```text
rule or_from_xor_and<W>(x: W, y: W) { (x ^ y) + (x & y) => x | y }
```

- `(p ^ q) + (p & q)` → `p | q`

#### `sub_and` — rule

Removing the common bits.

```text
rule sub_and<W>(x: W, y: W) { x - (x & y) => x & ~y }
```

- `p - (p & q)` → `p & ~q`

#### `neg_not` — rule

`-~x = x + 1`.

```text
rule neg_not<W>(x: W) { -(~x) => x + 1 }
```

- `-(~p)` → `p + 1`

#### `not_neg` — rule

`~-x = x - 1`.

```text
rule not_neg<W>(x: W) { ~(-x) => x - 1 }
```

- `~(-p)` → `p - 1`

#### `add_disjoint` — rule

An add without carries is an or.

```text
rule add_disjoint<W>(x: W, y: W) { x + y => x | y if disjoint(x, y) }
```

- `(p & 0xf0) + (q & 15)` → `(p & 0xf0) | (q & 15)`

#### `mul_pow2` — rule

Multiplying by a power of two is a shift.

```text
rule mul_pow2<W>(x: W, c: const W) { x * c => x << k if is_pow2(c) let k: W = ctz(c) }
```

- `p * 8` → `p << 3`

#### `udiv_pow2` — rule

Unsigned division by a power of two is a shift.

```text
rule udiv_pow2<W>(x: W, c: const W) { udiv(x, c) => x >>u k if is_pow2(c) let k: W = ctz(c) }
```

- `udiv(p, 16)` → `p >>u 4`

#### `urem_pow2` — rule

Unsigned remainder by a power of two is a mask.

```text
rule urem_pow2<W>(x: W, c: const W) { urem(x, c) => x & m if is_pow2(c) let m: W = c - 1 }
```

- `urem(p, 16)` → `p & 15`

### core.compare

#### `eq_sub_zero` — rule

A zero difference is equality.

```text
rule eq_sub_zero<W>(a: W, b: W) { (a - b) == 0 => a == b }
```

- `p - q == 0` → `p == q`

#### `eq_xor_zero` — rule

A zero xor is equality.

```text
rule eq_xor_zero<W>(a: W, b: W) { (a ^ b) == 0 => a == b }
```

- `(p ^ q) == 0` → `p == q`

#### `ult_one` — rule

Below one is zero.

```text
rule ult_one<W>(x: W) { x <u 1 => x == 0 }
```

- `p <u 1` → `p == 0`

#### `eq_eq_distinct` — rule

A value cannot equal two provably different values.

```text
rule eq_eq_distinct<W>(a: W, b: W, c: W) { (a == b) & (a == c) => false if proves(b != c) }
```

- `(p == 1) & (p == 2)` → `0:1`

#### `ult_zext` — rule

Unsigned comparison of zero-extended values is the narrow comparison.

```text
rule ult_zext<W, U>(a: W, b: W) where W < U { zext<U>(a) <u zext<U>(b) => a <u b }
```

- `zext<16>(p) <u zext<16>(q)` → `p <u q`

#### `slt_sext` — rule

Signed comparison of sign-extended values is the narrow comparison.

```text
rule slt_sext<W, U>(a: W, b: W) where W < U { sext<U>(a) <s sext<U>(b) => a <s b }
```

- `sext<16>(p) <s sext<16>(q)` → `p <s q`

#### `eq_zext` — rule

Equality of extended values is equality.

```text
rule eq_zext<W, U>(a: W, b: W) where W < U { zext<U>(a) == zext<U>(b) => a == b }
```

- `zext<16>(p) == zext<16>(q)` → `p == q`

### core.casts

#### `zext_trunc` — rule

Truncate, then zero-extend back: a mask.

```text
rule zext_trunc<W, N>(x: W) where N < W { zext<W>(trunc<N>(x)) => x & lowmask(N) }
```

- `zext<8>(trunc<4>(p))` → `p & 15`

#### `sext_from_sign_word` — rule

Sign extension spelled as "value | (sign word << W)". Needs `U <= 2W` to be exact.

```text
rule sext_from_sign_word<W, U>(a: W) where W < U, U <= 2 * W {
        zext<U>(a) | (zext<U>(a >>s (W - 1)) << W) => sext<U>(a)
    }
```

- `zext<16>(p) | (zext<16>(p >>s 7) << 8)` → `sext<16>(p)`

#### `trunc_and_zext` — rule

The low bits of a zero extension's operand.

```text
rule trunc_and_zext<W, U>(a: W, b: W) where W < U {
        trunc<W>(zext<U>(a) & zext<U>(b)) => a & b
    }
```

- `trunc<8>(zext<16>(p) & zext<16>(q))` → `p & q`

### core.select

#### `select_one_zero` — rule

A condition selecting one or zero is its zero extension.

```text
rule select_one_zero<W>(c: 1) where 1 < W { select(c, 1, 0) => zext<W>(c) }
```

- `select(p <u q, 1:16, 0:16)` → `zext<16>(p <u q)`

#### `select_ones_zero` — rule

A condition selecting all ones or zero is its sign extension.

```text
rule select_ones_zero<W>(c: 1) where 1 < W { select(c, ones, 0) => sext<W>(c) }
```

- `select(p <u q, 0xffff:16, 0:16)` → `sext<16>(p <u q)`

### core.shift

#### `shl_shl` — rule

Two left shifts by constants that do not overflow the width.

```text
rule shl_shl<W>(x: W, a: const W, b: const W) {
        (x << a) << b => x << k
        if (a <u W) && (b <u W) && (a + b <u W)
        let k: W = a + b
    }
```

- `(p << 2) << 3` → `p << 5`

#### `lshr_lshr` — rule

Two logical right shifts by constants that do not overflow the width.

```text
rule lshr_lshr<W>(x: W, a: const W, b: const W) {
        (x >>u a) >>u b => x >>u k
        if (a <u W) && (b <u W) && (a + b <u W)
        let k: W = a + b
    }
```

- `(p >>u 2) >>u 3` → `p >>u 5`

#### `lshr_shl` — rule

Shifting right then left by the same amount clears the low bits.

```text
rule lshr_shl<W>(x: W, c: const W) {
        (x >>u c) << c => x & m
        if c <u W
        let m: W = ones << c
    }
```

- `(p >>u 3) << 3` → `p & 0xf8`

#### `rotl_rotl` — rule

Two rotations by constants.

```text
rule rotl_rotl<W>(x: W, a: const W, b: const W) {
        rotl(rotl(x, a), b) => rotl(x, k)
        let k: W = urem(urem(a, W) + urem(b, W), W)
    }
```

- `rotl(rotl(p, 3), 7)` → `rotl(p, 2)`

#### `rotl_rotr` — rule

Rotating back by the same count, whatever it is.

```text
rule rotl_rotr<W>(x: W, y: W) { rotl(rotr(x, y), y) => x }
```

- `rotl(rotr(p, q), q)` → `p`

#### `rotr_rotl` — rule

Rotating back by the same count, whatever it is.

```text
rule rotr_rotl<W>(x: W, y: W) { rotr(rotl(x, y), y) => x }
```

- `rotr(rotl(p, q), q)` → `p`

## `eqsat.bwr`

### eqsat.assoc

#### `add_assoc` — identity (search only)

```text
identity add_assoc<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { (x + y) + z <=> x + (y + z) }
```

- `(p + q) + r` → `p + (q + r)`

#### `mul_assoc` — identity (search only)

```text
identity mul_assoc<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { (x * y) * z <=> x * (y * z) }
```

- `(p * q) * r` → `p * (q * r)`

#### `and_assoc` — identity (search only)

```text
identity and_assoc<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { (x & y) & z <=> x & (y & z) }
```

- `(p & q) & r` → `p & (q & r)`

#### `or_assoc` — identity (search only)

```text
identity or_assoc<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { (x | y) | z <=> x | (y | z) }
```

- `(p | q) | r` → `p | (q | r)`

#### `xor_assoc` — identity (search only)

```text
identity xor_assoc<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { (x ^ y) ^ z <=> x ^ (y ^ z) }
```

- `(p ^ q) ^ r` → `p ^ (q ^ r)`

### eqsat.distrib

#### `mul_add` — identity (search only)

```text
identity mul_add<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { x * (y + z) <=> x * y + x * z }
```

- `p * (q + r)` → `p * q + p * r`

### eqsat.distrib_and

#### `and_or` — identity (search only)

```text
identity and_or<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { x & (y | z) <=> (x & y) | (x & z) }
```

- `p & (q | r)` → `(p & q) | (p & r)`

#### `and_xor` — identity (search only)

```text
identity and_xor<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { x & (y ^ z) <=> (x & y) ^ (x & z) }
```

- `p & (q ^ r)` → `(p & q) ^ (p & r)`

### eqsat.distrib_or

#### `or_and` — identity (search only)

```text
identity or_and<W>(x: W, y: W, z: W) { x | (y & z) <=> (x | y) & (x | z) }
```

- `p | (q & r)` → `(p | q) & (p | r)`

### eqsat.negation

#### `de_morgan_and` — identity (search only)

```text
identity de_morgan_and<W>(x: W, y: W) { ~(x & y) <=> ~x | ~y }
```

- `~(p & q)` → `~p | ~q`

#### `de_morgan_or` — identity (search only)

```text
identity de_morgan_or<W>(x: W, y: W) { ~(x | y) <=> ~x & ~y }
```

- `~(p | q)` → `~p & ~q`

#### `neg_add` — identity (search only)

```text
identity neg_add<W>(x: W, y: W) { -(x + y) <=> -x + -y }
```

- `-(p + q)` → `-p + -q`

#### `neg_mul` — identity (search only)

```text
identity neg_mul<W>(x: W, y: W) { -(x * y) <=> -x * y }
```

- `-(p * q)` → `-p * q`

#### `not_xor` — identity (directed and search)

```text
identity not_xor<W>(x: W, y: W) { ~(x ^ y) <=> ~x ^ y }
```

- `~(p ^ q)` → `~p ^ q`

### eqsat.cancel

#### `add_sub` — rule

```text
rule add_sub<W>(x: W, y: W) { (x + y) - y => x }
```

- `(p + q) - q` → `p`

#### `sub_add` — rule

```text
rule sub_add<W>(x: W, y: W) { (x - y) + y => x }
```

- `(p - q) + q` → `p`

#### `xor_xor` — rule

```text
rule xor_xor<W>(x: W, y: W) { (x ^ y) ^ y => x }
```

- `(p ^ q) ^ q` → `p`

#### `neg_neg` — rule

```text
rule neg_neg<W>(x: W) { -(-x) => x }
```

#### `not_not` — rule

```text
rule not_not<W>(x: W) { ~(~x) => x }
```

#### `add_neg` — rule

```text
rule add_neg<W>(x: W) { x + -x => 0 }
```

- `p + -p` → `0`

#### `mul_one` — rule

```text
rule mul_one<W>(x: W) { x * 1 => x }
```

#### `mul_zero` — rule

```text
rule mul_zero<W>(x: W) { x * 0 => 0 }
```

#### `add_zero` — rule

```text
rule add_zero<W>(x: W) { x + 0 => x }
```
